_what_to_expect: A failure the corpus has never seen (tank safety valve). It must not be forced into the nearest existing 'valve' cause; it becomes a proposed new cause for expert review.

case.customer_description: Loud hiss from the tank, pressure won't build past 7 bar.
case.technician_notes: Safety valve lifting early at 7.2 bar, seat damaged. Replaced safety valve, builds to 10 bar.

root_cause.evidence_quote: Safety valve lifting early at 7.2 bar, seat damaged.
